message:
After some feedback, I edited the post a little: in its original form, it came across as confrontational, which wasn't my intent.

Anyway: [this story](/weblog/archives/2003/09/19/210-04-0102-o-neg-no-rel-pref/), with its *Kosovo Polje* center, is one that Daniel helped me write, and some of the details are drawn from his experience.
